en.text: Don’t fret because of evildoers, be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 不要为作恶的心怀不平，

zhTraditional.text: 不要為作惡的心懷不平，

en.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他们如草快被割下，

zhTraditional.text: 因為他們如草快被割下，

en.text: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

zhSimplified.text: 你当倚靠耶和华而行善，

zhTraditional.text: 你當倚靠耶和華而行善，

en.text: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

zhSimplified.text: 又要以耶和华为乐，

zhTraditional.text: 又要以耶和華為樂，

en.text: Commit your way to the LORD. also in him, and he will do this:

zhSimplified.text: 当将你的事交托耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 當將你的事交託耶和華，

en.text: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

zhSimplified.text: 他要使你的公义如光发出，

zhTraditional.text: 他要使你的公義如光發出，

en.text: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

zhSimplified.text: 你当默然倚靠耶和华，耐性等候他；

zhTraditional.text: 你當默然倚靠耶和華，耐性等候他；

en.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. fret; it leads only to evildoing.

zhSimplified.text: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒；

zhTraditional.text: 當止住怒氣，離棄忿怒；

en.text: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

zhSimplified.text: 因为作恶的必被剪除；

zhTraditional.text: 因為作惡的必被剪除；

en.text: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. you look for his place, he isn’t there.

zhSimplified.text: 还有片时，恶人要归于无有；

zhTraditional.text: 還有片時，惡人要歸於無有；

en.text: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

zhSimplified.text: 但谦卑人必承受地土，

zhTraditional.text: 但謙卑人必承受地土，

en.text: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人设谋害义人，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人設謀害義人，

en.text: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

zhSimplified.text: 主要笑他， 的日子将要来到。

zhTraditional.text: 主要笑他， 的日子將要來到。

en.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人已经弓上弦，刀出鞘，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人已經弓上弦，刀出鞘，

en.text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

zhSimplified.text: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心；

zhTraditional.text: 他們的刀必刺入自己的心；

en.text: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

zhSimplified.text: 一个义人所有的虽少，

zhTraditional.text: 一個義人所有的雖少，

en.text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

zhSimplified.text: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断；

zhTraditional.text: 因為惡人的膀臂必被折斷；

en.text: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华知道完全人的日子；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華知道完全人的日子；

en.text: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

zhSimplified.text: 他们在急难的时候不致羞愧，

zhTraditional.text: 他們在急難的時候不致羞愧，

en.text: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人却要灭亡。 ；

zhTraditional.text: 惡人卻要滅亡。 ；

en.text: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人借贷而不偿还；

zhTraditional.text: 惡人借貸而不償還；

en.text: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

zhSimplified.text: 蒙耶和华赐福的必承受地土；

zhTraditional.text: 蒙耶和華賜福的必承受地土；

en.text: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

zhSimplified.text: 义人的脚步被耶和华立定；

zhTraditional.text: 義人的腳步被耶和華立定；

en.text: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

zhSimplified.text: 他虽失脚也不至全身仆倒， 。

zhTraditional.text: 他雖失腳也不致全身仆倒， 。

en.text: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

zhSimplified.text: 我从前年幼，现在年老，

zhTraditional.text: 我從前年幼，現在年老，

en.text: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

zhSimplified.text: 他终日恩待人，借给人；

zhTraditional.text: 他終日恩待人，借給人；

en.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

zhSimplified.text: 你当离恶行善， 居。

zhTraditional.text: 你當離惡行善， 居。

en.text: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，耶和华喜爱公平，

zhTraditional.text: 因為，耶和華喜愛公平，

en.text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

zhSimplified.text: 义人必承受地土，

zhTraditional.text: 義人必承受地土，

en.text: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

zhSimplified.text: 义人的口谈论智慧；

zhTraditional.text: 義人的口談論智慧；

en.text: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

zhSimplified.text: 神的律法在他心里；

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的律法在他心裏；

en.text: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

zhSimplified.text: 恶人窥探义人，

zhTraditional.text: 惡人窺探義人，

en.text: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必不撇他在恶人手中；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必不撇他在惡人手中；

en.text: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

zhSimplified.text: 你当等候耶和华，遵守他的道，

zhTraditional.text: 你當等候耶和華，遵守他的道，

en.text: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

zhSimplified.text: 我见过恶人大有势力，

zhTraditional.text: 我見過惡人大有勢力，

en.text: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

zhSimplified.text: 有人从那里经过，不料，他没有了；

zhTraditional.text: 有人從那裏經過，不料，他沒有了；

en.text: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

zhSimplified.text: 你要细察那完全人，观看那正直人， 结局。

zhTraditional.text: 你要細察那完全人，觀看那正直人， 結局。

en.text: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

zhSimplified.text: 至于犯法的人，必一同灭绝；

zhTraditional.text: 至於犯法的人，必一同滅絕；

en.text: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

zhSimplified.text: 但义人得救是由于耶和华；

zhTraditional.text: 但義人得救是由於耶和華；

en.text: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华帮助他们，解救他们；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華幫助他們，解救他們；
